title: Finite-presentation modules on a ringed space have a set of isomorphism representatives
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal O_X$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Say that $\mathcal G\in\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ is of finite presentation if every $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ admitting an exact sequence $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U\to0$ with $m,n$ finite [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there are a set $I$ and finite-presentation modules $(\mathcal G_i)_{i\in I}$ such that every finite-presentation $\mathcal O_X$-module is isomorphic to some $\mathcal G_i$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BC (lemma-set-isomorphism-classes-finite-type-modules), lines 957-984; apply it because a module of finite presentation is of finite type by Modules, Definition 01BN

proof.text: For each open U let the local labels be triples (m,n,a) with m,n natural numbers and a a morphism from the free module on ULift(Fin m) to the free module on ULift(Fin n) on Over U. Define B(U,m,n,a) as the categorical cokernel of a. Morphism types and the dependent sum are in universe u, so these are small local-model families.

proof.text: Use Mathlib IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData. Each local finite presentation p expresses the restricted module as a cokernel by Presentation.isColimit. Identify its finite generator and relation types with lifted finite ordinals using Fintype.equivFin and map the equivalences through freeFunctor. Transport the cokernel universal property with IsCokernel.ofIso. Cokernel uniqueness identifies the corresponding localModel with the local restriction.

source.place: Tag 01BC, proof of lemma-set-isomorphism-classes-finite-type-modules, specialized to finite presentation using Definition 01BN

proof.text: Given a finitely presented module F, take the range of its presentation cover as a subset of Opens X. Choose a local label and isomorphism psi(U):B(U,t(U)) to F.over U for each member. Overlap transitions are psi(U) followed by psi(V) inverse after restriction, using overFunctorMap to identify iterated restrictions. Evaluation on each open and inverse cancellation prove the cocycle, defining d. Compose theta(d,U) with psi(U); the transition equations show these maps agree on overlaps, and their inverses agree by cancellation. Glue both families with glue_sheaves_of_modules. Its local equality criterion proves both composite identities, giving Phi(d) isomorphic to F.

proof.text: Take the subtype of all gluing data d for which Phi(d) has finite presentation. The data type is already in universe u. Each representative is finitely presented by definition; for any finitely presented F the preceding isomorphism and Mathlib isFinitePresentation.prop_of_iso put its representing d in this subtype.
